critical_code_review_comments: app/services/push.py grant_pass uses ISO strings in push_passes.{tid} for TTL comparison; pass_active does lexicographic string compare vs datetime.now().isoformat() — works for UTC ISO but silently breaks if a caller ever stores a tz-aware string with offset (e.g. +02:00) since '+' > 'Z' collation. Safe today (only grant_pass writes) but noted.
routers/push.py _fan_tournaments: computes push.push_price(t.id) once per tournament in a per-request loop; for many tournaments this issues N settings_repo queries. Minor perf, acceptable for MVP.

routers/push.py `subscribe`: label truncation `body.label[:80] or (user-agent)[:80]` — falsy for empty string only, but if a client sends whitespace-only label it will be stored as-is; consider `.strip()`.

services/push.send_to_user: on send failure with status None (non-WebPushException) the subscription is kept — good defensive default; make sure LOG entries are visible enough to alert on stuck fake endpoints (currently WARNING only).

roster_imports.parse_workbook: iterates rows 11..ws.max_row — trailing formatted blank rows in openpyxl can push max_row well beyond FIRST_ROW+40; guarded by the `if not any(...)` check so OK, but consider capping at 200 to avoid pathological workbooks.
services/roster_template: `page_setup.paperSize = ws.PAPERSIZE_A4` — PAPERSIZE_A4 is an int (9). Works. Consider setting `ws.print_options.horizontalCentered = True` for cleaner A4 print.

roster_imports.approve: enforces unique shirt numbers within the modulo but does NOT prevent collision with EXISTING active players in the same team not present in the modulo (merge mode). Duplicate numbers in DB become possible if operator approves merge with a shirt already used by another active player. Consider adding a cross-check against the current roster.
